Staying near TCS Brigade Bhuwalka Icon in ITPL offers convenience, proximity to tech parks, and a vibrant lifestyle. Let’s explore the best areas to live in this vicinity.

Table of Contents

Brookefield is a cool area in Bangalore with homes and shops. It's easy to get around Brookefield because it has big roads like ITPL Main Road, Kundanahalli Main Road and HAL Old Airport Road. Many places are close by, like Marathahalli, Whitefield, and Munnekollal. Because there are so many jobs nearby and it's easy to get to stores and schools, more and more people are choosing to live here. There are mostly tall apartment buildings in Brookefield. Brookefield is also close to National Highway 45 and Whitefield Main Road, which are about 3 to 5 kilometers away. You can get to other parts of Bangalore easily using the big Intermediate Ring Road, which is 188 kilometers long. The closest train station is Whitefield railway station, which is 8.2 kilometers away. The airport is farther away, at 39.5 kilometers.

BEML Layout is a popular place to live in Brookefield, on the east side of Bangalore. It's in high demand because it has great places to shop and play, and it's easy to get to ITPL.  Big roads like HAL Old Airport Road, ITPL Main Road and Kundalahalli Main Road connect BEML Layout to other parts of the city. The Whitefield Railway station is 9.8 kilometers away, and the nearest metro station is 3.3 kilometers away. The airport is farther away, at 41.1 kilometers.

Hoodi is an area in Bangalore that's becoming a popular place to live. It's on the east side of the city. There are many companies around Hoodi, so it's a good choice for people who work in ITPL. Big roads like Whitefield Main Road and Kundalahalli Main Road help you get around. Trains are also an option, with the Hoodi Halt Railway Station nearby.

Maithri Layout is a neighborhood in Kadugodi, on the eastern side of Bangalore.  It's close to other areas like Brookfield and Hoodi. Many companies are in ITPL Whitefield, just 3.5 kilometers away, which is why some people choose to live in rental flats in Maithri Layout. There are big roads to get around, like Whitefield Hoskote Road and Channasandra Main Road. There's also a metro station built nearby for even easier travel. The Whitefield railway station is 750 meters away, and the airport is farther, at 35.6 kilometers.

Conclusion

Brookefield, BEML Layout, Hoodi and Maithri Layout are all good places to live near TCS Brigade Bhuwalka Icon and ITPL. These areas are close by and easy to get to because they have big roads and Metro stations. As there are lots of jobs nearby and it's easy to get around, these areas are popular with people who want to live in Bangalore.

FAQs

Q. Is Brookefield safe for families?
A. Yes, Brookefield is a safe residential area with good security measures.
Q. What amenities are available in BEML Layout?
A. BEML Layout offers modern amenities such as parks, schools, and shopping centers.
Q. How far is Hoodi from ITPL?
A. Hoodi is conveniently close to ITPL, making it an ideal residential choice.
